items.text: re-label and re-balance the hubs menus, deduplicating the duplicate options, propose determine a better taxonomy for its categories with a list of which options will go in which menu, no longer packing unrelated options like design and documentation together etc
there are still two /hubs commands, only one (that runs a menu not one that prints the index) should be listed
resource-hub setup functionality should be handled within the hubs-setup running through the potentially useful resources based on the codebase during installs, refreshes or other hubs-setup tooling
There should only be a single setup+install related setup for the hubs menus in hubs-setup, where all the scattered tooling for the hubs menus must be gathered
